title: What Lunar Solar Farms Is
definition: Lunar Solar Farms: solar farms built from Moon dust on the lunar surface.
description:
Lunar Solar Farms: solar farms built from Moon dust on the lunar surface. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — regolith panels research, farm logistics engineering and lunar manufacturing operations converging on a single goal: making farm hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide power beaming outcomes this century. Lunar Solar Farms is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working farm hulls, the larger regolith panels vision stalls, and with it, the farm logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Lunar Solar Farms in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Lunar Solar Farms
title: Real Research Today: Lunar Solar Farms
definition: Today's documented research behind Lunar Solar Farms.
description:
The road to Lunar Solar Farms is already being paved. Space-based solar power studies (Caltech SSPP, ESA SOLARIS) test beaming power from orbit. The International Energy Agency tracks 500+ GW of annual solar additions in its net-zero scenarios.

ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation. Together these programs form the regolith panels foundation that Lunar Solar Farms will build on — the farm logistics results, the lunar manufacturing methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as farm logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First commercial farm hulls plant sells regolith panels power to
title: 2032 — First commercial farm hulls plant sells regolith panels power to
definition: 2032 milestone on the Lunar Solar Farms roadmap.
description:
First commercial farm hulls plant sells regolith panels power to the grid under a 20-year power beaming contract.

What must be true first: the regolith panels results have to replicate outside the lab, farm logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and lunar manufacturing operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed regolith panels demonstrations, farm logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting lunar manufacturing uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Lunar Solar Farms
definition: Estimates Lunar Solar Farms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Lunar Solar Farms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a farm hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Lunar Solar Farms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Lunar Solar Farms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Lunar Solar Farms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 29075 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where regolith panels monitoring, farm logistics redundancy, or lunar manufacturing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Lunar Solar Farms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Lunar Solar Farms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Lunar Solar Farms — solar farms built from Moon dust on the lunar surface.

Phase 1 — Prove (regolith panels): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (farm logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (lunar manufacturing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (power beaming): farm hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and lunar surface-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
